instructions: 1. Place raw garment flat-lay or mannequin reference photos inside inputs/cloth/<productId>.jpg
2. Use Angle 1 prompt to generate the front full-body studio model image first.
3. Pass Angle 1 as the reference image for Angles 2-5 so model identity, lighting, and garment drape remain 100% consistent across all 5 views.
4. Save outputs to public/products/<productId>/angle-1.jpg .. angle-5.jpg or host on CDN and sync via Studio Setup -> Link Sync.

angleTemplates.label: Front Full Look
angleTemplates.promptTemplate: Single undivided vertical portrait studio fashion photograph (9:16 portrait aspect ratio, no split screen, no collage) of a confident Gen-Z Indian female model standing full-body head-to-toe facing the camera wearing {{GARMENT_DESCRIPTION}}, natural skin texture, editorial DSLR 85mm lighting.

angleTemplates.label: Side Walking Silhouette
angleTemplates.promptTemplate: Single undivided vertical portrait studio fashion photograph (9:16 portrait aspect ratio) of the exact same model and {{GARMENT_DESCRIPTION}} in a dynamic 3/4 side walking stride showing side pocket placement, rise, and fabric movement.

angleTemplates.label: Back Waistband & Fall
angleTemplates.promptTemplate: Single undivided vertical portrait studio fashion photograph (9:16 portrait aspect ratio) of the exact same model and {{GARMENT_DESCRIPTION}} from a rear 3/4 angle glancing back over her shoulder, highlighting back waistband comfort and full-length drape.

angleTemplates.label: Waist & Fabric Close-Up
angleTemplates.promptTemplate: Single undivided vertical mid-shot fashion photograph (9:16 portrait aspect ratio) from waist to ankle of the same model wearing {{GARMENT_DESCRIPTION}}, hand resting in side pocket to showcase stitching, pleats, and fabric weave.

angleTemplates.label: Styled Street Editorial
angleTemplates.promptTemplate: Single undivided vertical dusk street-style lookbook photograph (9:16 portrait aspect ratio) of the exact same model wearing {{GARMENT_DESCRIPTION}} outside a modern neon-accented cafe terrace.
